# The finding is the draft

Almost every slow draft in the archive was slow because the finding was fuzzy, not
because the writing was hard. When the finding is stated crisply with its evidence
and denominator before drafting begins, the draft takes minutes; when drafting starts
first, the writer ends up doing analysis with a thesaurus. Refuse to draft until the
finding fits in one sentence a practitioner would repeat.
